lead: `bun nv gaps --errors` matches a site by its message *before the first format hole*, so closing one member can silence its siblings.
body: A case echoing `Core\Time\DateTime::format(): …` contains the stem `Core\Time\DateTime::`, which is the whole stem of every message spelled `Core\Time\DateTime::{member}(…)`. The list in `tools/nv/cmd/gaps.ts` is a worklist, not a ledger: when the drop is larger than the number of sites you asserted, diff it against the tree with your new cases moved aside and name the hidden ones in the handoff.
